basic.name: Lion's Fang
basic.description: Create a shockwave that travels in a straight line, dealing 150~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing enemies by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Each enemy hit heals Varian for 35~~0.04~~, increased to 140~~0.04~~ against Heroes.

basic.name: Parry
basic.description:
Parry all incoming Basic Attacks for 1.25 seconds, reducing their damage by 100%.

Stores up to 2 charges.

basic.name: Charge
basic.description: Charge to the target enemy, dealing 50~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing them by 75% for 1 second.

heroic.name: Taunt
heroic.description:
Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds.

Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.

heroic.name: Colossus Smash
heroic.description:
Smash a target enemy, dealing 185~~0.04~~ damage and lowering their Armor by 25 for 3 seconds, causing them to take 25% increased damage.

Passive: Base Attack Damage increased by 100%.
Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration reduced by 10%.

heroic.name: Twin Blades of Fury
heroic.description:
Basic Attacks reduce Heroic Strike's cooldown by an additional 7 seconds, and increase Varian's Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

Passive: Attack Speed increased by 100%.
Passive: Base Attack Damage reduced by 25%.

trait.name: Heroic Strike
trait.description: Every 18 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack deals 125~~0.04~~ bonus Spell Damage. Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

activable.name: Victory Rush
activable.description: Every 30 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack will heal him for 350~~0.04~~ Health. When a nearby enemy Minion or Monster dies, the cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

activable.name: Shattering Throw
activable.description:
Activate to throw a sword at a target Hero that deals 50~~0.04~~ damage, and up to 1400~~0.04~~ bonus damage to their Shields.

Passive: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal up to 200% bonus Physical Damage to Shields.

activable.name: Banner of Dalaran
activable.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 20% increased Spell Power to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

activable.name: Banner of Ironforge
activable.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 20 Armor to nearby allied Heroes, reducing damage taken by 20%. Lasts 12 seconds.

activable.name: Banner of Stormwind
activable.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 25% increased Movement Speed to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

activable.name: Demoralizing Shout
activable.description:
Activate to demoralize nearby enemy Heroes, reducing damage they deal by 40% for 5 seconds.

Each time an enemy Hero affected by Demoralizing Shout deals damage to a Hero, reduce its cooldown and Parry's cooldown by 5%.

level1.name: Lion's Maw
level1.description:
Quest: Every time Lion's Fang hits a Hero, increase its damage by 7, up to 175.

Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, the Slow is increased to 50% and its duration is increased to 2 seconds.

level1.name: Overpower
level1.description: When Parry blocks a Hero's Basic Attack, Heroic Strike's cooldown is refreshed and the next one does 40% more damage.

level1.name: High King's Quest
level1.description:
Quest: Hit 50 Heroes with Basic Attacks.
Quest: Participate in 5 Hero Takedowns.
Quest: Gather 15 Regeneration Globes.

Reward: Completing a Quest grants 10 Base Attack Damage. Completing all 3 Quests grants an additional 30 Base Attack Damage.

level7.description: Increase Lion's Fang's healing from Heroes by 75%.

level7.name: Second Wind
level7.description: Basic Attacks heal Varian for 1% of his maximum Health. While below 50% Health, they also heal him for 50% of the damage dealt.

level10.name: Shield Wall
level10.description: Parry grants Protected, preventing all incoming damage while active. Additionally, Parry's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds, but it loses 1 charge.

level10.name: Warbringer
level10.description: Reduce Charge's cooldown by 8 seconds and Mana cost from 45 to 25. Additionally, Charge can be cast on allied Heroes.

level13.name: Juggernaut
level13.description: Charge deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 4% of their maximum Health.

level13.name: Mortal Strike
level13.description: Heroes hit by Heroic Strike receive 40% reduced healing for 4 seconds.

level20.description: Being hit by a Hero Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Taunt by 1 second.

level20.name: Master at Arms
level20.description: Colossus Smash affects all enemies near the target, and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

level20.name: Frenzy
level20.description: Twin Blades of Fury increases Heroic Strike damage by an additional 25%, and Basic Attacks increase his Movement Speed by an additional 10%.

level20.name: Glory to the Alliance
level20.description: Banner now also increases health regeneration and all healing received for nearby allied Heroes by 50%, and the cooldown is reduced by 50%.
